message: the YouTube API returned HTTP 500; today is unmeasured and tomorrow re-reads the same numbers
detail: failing call: https://youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com/v2/reports ids=channel==MINE startDate=2020-01-01 endDate=2026-11-08 metrics=views dimensions=video,insightTrafficSourceType filters=video==<37 ids> (after 3 retries when transient)
unblock: Usually transient. Two weeks running means the project or quota needs looking at.
disposition_why: 'ANALYTICS_HTTP_500' has now stopped demand-pull on 5 consecutive runs (limit 2), so it is not resolving itself. Two runs of 5xx in a row outlives any normal Google incident - check the request shape, and remember that estimatedRevenue beside ordinary metrics fails the WHOLE call.
